context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren plan an overseas expansion.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business strategy; vocabulary (進出/最適/概要/正式/やがて) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外への進出を、考えているんだ。
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 計画の概要を、まとめました。
lines.en: I compiled an overview of the plan.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: アジアが、最適だと考えます。
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 正式な発表は、いつにするかね?
lines.en: When do we make the formal announcement?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 準備が整えば、正式に発表します。
lines.en: Once ready, we'll announce it formally.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: やがて、世界に届く会社にしたいな。
lines.en: Eventually, I want a company that reaches the world.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 概要を踏まえ、進出を進めます。
lines.en: Based on the overview, I'll advance the expansion.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
